name: Joshua Adedotun Obi
intro: I design digital products, AI workflows, and visual systems that turn complex ideas into clear, useful experiences.
biography: I’m a child in the playground when I design. I’m curious, open, and ready to explore whatever catches my eye. There’s a joy to trying things, to pushing limits, to letting instinct lead the way.

But there’s also a kind of precision to it. I’ll spend hours fine-tuning details most people might never notice, not for perfection’s sake, but because I care how things feel. Sometimes I’m deep in the weeds like a mad scientist, chasing a vision only I can see. Other times, I step back like a creative director, guiding others toward clarity with a sharp eye and a strong sense of purpose.

For me, design is less about tools and trends, and more about rhythm, emotion, and resonance. I see, I think, I imagine, I build, and every time, it’s a little different. But the goal stays the same: work that holds meaning. Work that lives.
about: I’m Joshua Adedotun Obi, a Brand & Systems Designer working across digital products, AI workflows, and creative technology. With seven years of experience, I combine strategy, visual design, interface thinking, and structured experimentation to help ideas become clearer, more useful, and easier to scale.
Through XAI, my design studio, I help businesses go beyond aesthetics. I follow the idea across disciplines, then build the visual language, digital experience or workflow it needs.
personalNote: I’m a shy but bold creative. I might hide my face, but never my work.
